reviews.title: Charge £40, do not download
reviews.text:
I used this app once to make a couple photos into PDF because iPhones can’t do that without a 3rd party app which is bad in itself. 
Then after a few days of having the I see I got charged £39.99 for a subscription that I never asked for or wanted! 
I had no notifications, warnings or anything along those lines about a free trial ending. They do this so they can scam people out of their money for using an app once! If they were an actual reputable customer friendly app they’d make this much clearer and obvious, also they’d have a trial for a lot longer than a few days! 
Tried to get a refund and they don’t deal with that so have to contact Apple and no! Not eligible for a refund. Scammers! 
DO NOT DOWNLOAD!

reviews.title: They Didn’t cancel subscription
reviews.text: Unfortunately I used this app once. I found that a lot of the words weren’t picked up or were different words and I spent time re editing the transcript. Also, tried to cancel before trial ended but was then charged for 3 subsequent weeks without noticing and when asked for money back as hadn’t used it. Have heard nothing
